name: Max Cooper no Hard Club, Porto
description: Max Cooper brings his new album, Feeling Is Structure, to Hard Club in Porto. This immersive audiovisual experience combines visual art and computational sound.
longDescription:
Max Cooper performs at Hard Club in Porto on November 6, 2026. The electronic music artist will present his new album, Feeling Is Structure, in an immersive audiovisual show that blends visual art and computational sound.

The doors open at 20:30, and the concert starts at 21:00. Tickets are available from €28. Minors under 16 can attend if accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

This event is part of Primavera Tours, a series of concerts that extends the spirit of the Primavera Sound festival throughout the year.

As portas abrem às 20:30 e o concerto começa às 21:00. Os bilhetes estão disponíveis a partir de 28€. Menores de 16 anos podem entrar se acompanhados por um dos pais ou tutor legal.

Este evento faz parte do Primavera Tours, uma série de concertos que estende o espírito do festival Primavera Sound ao longo do ano.
